text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...
...Whoops, another pudd—whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... My hem is soaking wet...
Ugh, it's so hard to run like this...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Steady as she goes!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
!! That's Tap-chan!
Amazing, she's dodging the puddles so gracefully...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Bad track conditions like this
won't even cause a ripple! Now, one more lap—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Your running earlier was amazing!
It was like you were dancing around the puddles!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Is there some kind of trick to it? A secret technique... to run without getting bogged down by puddles!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A puddle?
...Ah, there certainly is one—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—However, I wouldn't know.
There's no such thing charted on my nautical map.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I am merely choosing
the path that suits me best!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Just take the steps you envisioned!
Come on, draw up your own blueprint!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My steps...
...Umm, kind of like this—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaah!? ...Ugh...! 
Whenever I see a puddle, my body just reflexively...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's right, I have to step to my own rhythm!
My blueprint... my ideal—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll become someone who simply aims for the peak... and charges straight for the goal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha, look at you, completely covered in mud. ...So? Did you find your own step?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! I found it! Namely, that my footing is unsteady!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I was... too caught up in what was right in front of me.
I've been running with such narrow vision.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Once I realized that, I stopped worrying about the puddles
and focused on the path I needed to take."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So, this mud-covered jersey is proof of my growth!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now that's a good look on your face!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gained valuable insight, Narita Top Road's running
became significantly sharper as a result!
